debrief db-021

2) the a-c-t-o-r f-o-r-g-e-d o-w-n-e-r-s-h-i-p h-i-s-t-o-r-y d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s d-a-t-e-d b-e-f-o-r-e l-e-g-a-l a-c-q-u-i-s-i-t-i-o-n o-f s-t-o-c-k a-n-d f-i-l-e-d t-h-e-m i-n-t-o p-h-y-s-i-c-a-l f-i-l-e-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g t-h-e r-e-a-l t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r l-o-g a-u-d-i-t
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-r-e-a-t-e-d c-o-p-y o-f f-i-c-t-i-t-i-o-n a-l l-i-c-e-n-s-e n-u-m-b-e-r-s a-n-d u-p-l-o-a-d-e-d i-m-a-g-e-s o-f d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s t-o a c-l-o-u-d d-r-i-v-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g c-o-n-s-u-l-t-a-t-i-o-n w-i-t-h w-i-l-d-l-i-f-e o-f-f-i-c-e-r-s o-r j-u-r-i-s-d-i-c-t-i-o-n-s r-e-g-u-l-a-t-i-o-n-s
4) the a-c-t-o-r d-r-a-f-t-e-d o-n-l-i-n-e l-i-s-t-i-n-g-s u-s-i-n-g t-e-r-m-s l-i-k-e "c-a-p-t-i-v-e b-r-e-e-d" a-n-d "d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-e-d" t-o m-i-m-i-c l-e-g-i-t-i-m-a-t-e s-e-l-l-e-r-s o-n w-e-b-s-i-t-e-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g c-h-e-c-k-s f-o-r p-l-a-t-f-o-r-m t-e-r-m-s o-f s-e-r-v-i-c-e b-a-n-n-i-n-g w-i-l-d-c-a-t-c-h t-r-a-d-e
5) the a-c-t-o-r a-r-c-h-i-v-e-d t-h-e e-x-h-i-b-i-t s-t-a-t-e-m-e-n-t a-s "c-l-o-s-e-d m-a-t-t-e-r" w-i-t-h-o-u-t r-e-t-r-i-e-v-i-n-g o-r a-n-a-l-y-z-i-n-g t-h-e f-u-l-l s-t-a-k-e t-r-a-c-e o-f d-e-c-i-s-i-o-n-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g m-a-n-d-a-t-o-r-y i-n-c-i-d-e-n-t r-e-p-o-r-t i-n-g t-o s-u-p-e-r-v-i-s-o-r-s
